ato.name: Avatar Texture Optimizer
ato.enabled.tip: Master toggle for texture optimization on this avatar.
ato.whitelist.tip: Meshes/materials/textures/animations to skip. A texture referenced by a whitelisted object is fully skipped; other textures sharing its UV skip atlasing but still get whole-texture scaling and import optimization.
ato.preset.tip: Low/Medium/High/Very High/Near Lossless apply recommended thresholds. Custom is never overwritten.
ato.density.tip: Pixels per world meter. Islands are clamped to this range and by their true source pixel size.
ato.generateAtlas.tip: When off, do not cull/repack UVs; only scale whole textures.
ato.npot.tip: Use non-power-of-two atlas dimensions. Strips unsupported formats (e.g. iOS PVRTC).
report.title: Avatar Texture Optimizer — Report
report.summary: Processed {0} renderers, {1} textures, {2} islands into {3} atlases in {4} ms.
err.duplicateComponent: Multiple Avatar Texture Optimizer components found. Only one is allowed per avatar (including descendants). Remove the extra component(s).
err.noDescriptor: Avatar Texture Optimizer must be placed on a GameObject with a VRCAvatarDescriptor.
err.canceled: Avatar Texture Optimizer bake was cancelled by the user.
warn.crossSeam: Texture '{0}' has UVs that cross a wrap seam and cannot be safely repacked; it was skipped.
warn.unknownShader: Shader '{0}' on material '{1}' could not be classified; its textures were skipped.
warn.transform: Texture '{0}' on material '{1}' has UV ST/tiling/offset (or animation of it); skipped.
warn.tooBigForAtlas: Island(s) from '{0}' do not fit the largest atlas; kept as a scaled standalone texture.
warn.formatFallback: Compression format on '{0}' fell back to a safe format ({1}).
warn.singleChannelMismatch: A grayscale atlas contained multi-channel content; saved as multi-channel.
